📍 Amor 🔥 AMOR at Amoy Street — worth the hype or just atas vibes? Boujee but still justifiable (aka payday treat 😏). Spanish flavours, sexy plating, and every dish lowkey saying: “you deserve this.” We went all in!! 🐟 Tea Smoked King Salmon + Caviar Rich people starter energy 😭 Buttery, melts in your mouth, caviar pops with salty bursts. Balanced, indulgent… I almost checked my Toto app. 🍖 Iberico Pork Ribs Torch rosemary in front of you — aroma already wins. Super tender, juicy. Flavour leans lighter, more clean than bold. 🥩 Wagyu Short Ribs Soft, rich, with a slight sweetness. Balanced, comforting, easy to love. 🐟 Mediterranean Seabream Flaky, moist, clean flavours. Simple… but done right. 🥘 Seafood Paella Must order at any Spanish spot 😏 Rich seafood flavour, just wished for more crispy socarrat. 🥚 Happy Egggg Most atas egg ever 😂 Creamy, silky, comforting — lowkey addictive. 🌶 Padron Peppers Simple, light seasoning. Not my favourite, but easy to snack. 🍅 Pa Amb Tomaquet Fresh, light — perfect balance to cut the richness. 🧀 Jamón Iberico Croquettas THIS ONE 🔥 Crispy outside, creamy inside, full umami. Dangerous. 🍫 Pan con Chocolate Nice flame show 😅 Taste is more subtle — didn’t hit as hard for me. 🍰 Hazelnut Chocolate Lava Cake THE STAR 🤤 Break it — gooey lava flows out. Rich, nutty, indulgent. Must order. 🧀 Basque Cheesecake Creamy with slight bitterness… but lava cake stole the show 😂 💣 Bombas Crispy, savoury bites — great for sharing. 💭 Final Verdict Not everyday makan spot… but for a treat night? Worth it. Some hits, some misses — but overall vibe + experience = solid. 📍 107 Amoy Street, Singapore 🕒 Mon–Sat: 12PM–3PM | 6PM–12AM #AmorSG #AmoyStreet #SingaporeFood #SGFoodie #FoodgasmSG
